title: game/weather.json
description: The weather (E04): its kinds as rows of channels, the kind a new game starts in and the time a change takes. Loaded by WeatherData (Vocaterra.Game.Core); GameDataValidator checks the values (ids unique, a precipitation kind exactly when the intensity is above zero, every next known, a transition no longer than the shortest spell).

generated_by.description: Who or what wrote the file (hand-authored).

start.description: The id of the kind a new game starts in.

transitionSeconds.description: How long a change from one kind to the next takes to blend the channels; not above the shortest spell.

kind.description: The style of what falls (a consumer's table knows it); empty for none.

intensity.description: Above zero exactly when kind is set.

minSeconds.description: The shortest a spell of this kind lasts.

maxSeconds.description: The longest a spell lasts; not below minSeconds.

next.description: The kinds that may follow, id to a positive whole-number weight. Required unless this is the only kind.

morningWeight.description: The weight in the draw made on waking; 0 for never. At least one kind needs one above zero.

say.description: The dialogue keys of the NPCs' answer (E07 fills and validates them).
